skill.desc:
Cast Echo Skill to deal 16 instances of Physical DMG equal to {2} of ATK to the enemies within the range.
When Lucy or Rebecca has this Echo equipped in the main slot, their Crit. Rate is increased by {4} and they unlock special Echo Skills.

If equipped by Lucy:
- {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} the Echo Skill button to deal Spectro DMG equal to {0} of ATK to nearby enemies.
- Hold the Echo Skill button to deal Spectro DMG equal to {0} of ATK to nearby enemies and enter a special moving state, increasing Lucy's movement speed while slowing nearby enemies.

If equipped by Rebecca:
- Cast Echo Skill to fire missiles, dealing 16 instances of Electro DMG equal to {1} of ATK to the enemies.
CD: {3}s
